intent: 在主工作区继续滚动时，让次要但持续相关的状态、检查或操作保持可见。
use_when: 辅助信息需要跨越主内容滚动持续可见
辅助区域有明确次级任务身份
宽屏或横屏存在足够空间维持双区布局
do_not_use_when: 辅助内容会遮挡主要操作
窄屏无法为两个区域保留可用尺寸
任务实际上要求模态阻断

interaction_contract.positioning: viewport-relative within its layout containing block
interaction_contract.internal_scroll: allowed only when pane exceeds available viewport height
interaction_contract.narrow_viewport: must fall back to non-sticky stacked or alternate presentation

visual_contract.blur: optional; sticky behavior must not be described as blur
visual_contract.shadow: may express elevation but must not be the only semantic cue

constraints: Sticky behavior and backdrop blur are separate mechanisms.
The pane must remain reachable after viewport reduction.
Ancestor overflow and containing-block behavior must be tested.
Nested scrolling must not create accidental double-scroll traps.

provenance.note: Tablet landscape output pane exposed the distinction between sticky spatial layering and backdrop blur.
Kept experimental; one visual case is insufficient for Canonical promotion.
